scripts.lint: eslint src/ tests/ scripts/ vite.config.ts vitest.config.ts wdio.browser-mock.config.mjs wdio.native.config.mjs eslint.config.mjs
scripts.format: prettier --write src/ tests/ scripts/ README.md README.zh-CN.md ARCHITECTURE.md CHANGELOG.md CONTRIBUTING.md SECURITY.md package.json pnpm-workspace.yaml .markdownlint-cli2.yaml vite.config.ts vitest.config.ts wdio.browser-mock.config.mjs wdio.native.config.mjs eslint.config.mjs tsconfig.json tsconfig.node.json tsconfig.eslint.json index.html .github/workflows/ && cargo fmt --manifest-path src-tauri/Cargo.toml
scripts.format:check: prettier --check src/ tests/ scripts/ README.md README.zh-CN.md ARCHITECTURE.md CHANGELOG.md CONTRIBUTING.md SECURITY.md package.json pnpm-workspace.yaml .markdownlint-cli2.yaml vite.config.ts vitest.config.ts wdio.browser-mock.config.mjs wdio.native.config.mjs eslint.config.mjs tsconfig.json tsconfig.node.json tsconfig.eslint.json index.html .github/workflows/ && cargo fmt --manifest-path src-tauri/Cargo.toml -- --check
scripts.test: pnpm run test:frontend && pnpm run test:rust
scripts.quality:frontend: pnpm run lint && pnpm run lint:markdown && pnpm run lint:shell && pnpm run format:check && pnpm run architecture && pnpm run build && pnpm run bundle:check
scripts.quality:rust: cargo run -p xtask --locked -- bindings --check && cargo fmt --manifest-path src-tauri/Cargo.toml -- --check && cargo clippy --manifest-path src-tauri/Cargo.toml --workspace --all-targets --all-features --locked -- -D warnings
scripts.precommit: pnpm run toolchain:check && pnpm run lint && pnpm run lint:markdown && pnpm run lint:shell && pnpm run format:check && pnpm run architecture && pnpm run build && pnpm run bundle:check
scripts.precommit:full: pnpm run precommit && pnpm run test:frontend && pnpm run test:rust && pnpm run e2e:browser:local
scripts.test:local: pnpm run test:frontend && pnpm run test:rust
scripts.test:local:full: pnpm run test:local && pnpm run e2e:browser:local
scripts.check: pnpm run lint && pnpm run lint:markdown && pnpm run lint:shell && pnpm run format:check && pnpm run architecture && pnpm run build && pnpm run bundle:check && pnpm run test
